Analysis

Era 8 of 8

2022 to 2026: Ukraine and fragmentation

Opened by: Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

Output falls to 44 a year; 2025 has 44, the lowest since 1991. Middle East 20%, the Americas (mostly Haiti) 10%. Russia (13) and the US (9) lead the vetoes. The one adopted Ukraine resolution (2774 (2025)) speaks of a "conflict", with no finding of aggression or breach.

218resolutions
44per year
66%adopted unanimously
22vetoed drafts
50%under Chapter VII

Where the Council looked

Region of the situationShare
Africa47%
Middle East20%
Europe6%
Asia7%
Americas10%
Thematic3%
Institutional4%
Other4%

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Climate change: 4% to 16%
  • Ceasefires: 22% to 32%

Vetoes

22 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 13, United States 9, China 3. 13 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
